full_judgment: 14. From the statement of the petition it appears that the petitioner has approached this court under the Provisions of Section 233 of the Companies Act 1994 practically on the ground that the affairs of the respondent No.1 company are being conducted or the power of the directors of the respondent No.1 company are being exercised in a manner prejudicial to and in disregard to his interest in the company being the minority shareholding of 15% of the entire paid up capital. Therefore, the burden of proof is on the shoulder of the petitioner as the petitioner has brought the allegation against the other shareholder directors of the company that they are acting in a manner which is prejudicial to his minority shareholding interest in the company.
